statements:
CREATE TABLE alembic_version (
	version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num)
)

CREATE TABLE canonicalepisode (
	tvdb_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	season INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	episode INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	normalized_title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	last_synced_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_canonicalepisode PRIMARY KEY (tvdb_id, season, episode)
)

CREATE TABLE canonicalmovie (
	tmdb_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	normalized_title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	release_year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	imdb_id VARCHAR, 
	tvdb_id INTEGER, 
	last_synced_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_canonicalmovie PRIMARY KEY (tmdb_id)
)

CREATE TABLE canonicalseries (
	tvdb_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	normalized_title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tmdb_id INTEGER, 
	imdb_id VARCHAR, 
	tvmaze_id INTEGER, 
	anilist_id INTEGER, 
	mal_id INTEGER, 
	last_synced_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_canonicalseries PRIMARY KEY (tvdb_id)
)

CREATE TABLE canonicalseriesalias (
	tvdb_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	alias VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	normalized_alias VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_canonicalseriesalias PRIMARY KEY (tvdb_id, alias)
)

CREATE TABLE clienttask (
	hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	season INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	episode INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	language VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	site VARCHAR, 
	job_id VARCHAR, 
	save_path VARCHAR, 
	category VARCHAR, 
	added_on DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completion_on DATETIME, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, provider VARCHAR, mode VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (hash)
)

CREATE TABLE "episodeavailability" (
            slug TEXT NOT NULL,
            season INTEGER NOT NULL,
            episode INTEGER NOT NULL,
            language TEXT NOT NULL,
            site TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aniworld.to',
            available BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
            height INTEGER,
            vcodec TEXT,
            provider TEXT,
            checked_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
            extra JSON,
            PRIMARY KEY (slug, season, episode, language, site)
        )

CREATE TABLE job (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	progress FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	downloaded_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	total_bytes INTEGER, 
	speed FLOAT, 
	eta INTEGER, 
	message VARCHAR, 
	result_path VARCHAR, 
	source_site VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "providercatalogalias" (
                    provider VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    slug VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    alias VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    indexed_generation VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    normalized_alias VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    last_indexed_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY (provider, slug, alias, indexed_generation)
                )

CREATE TABLE "providercatalogepisode" (
                    provider VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    slug VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    season INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    episode INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    indexed_generation VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    title_primary VARCHAR,
                    title_secondary VARCHAR,
                    relative_path VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    media_type_hint VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    last_indexed_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY (provider, slug, season, episode, indexed_generation)
                )

CREATE TABLE "providercatalogtitle" (
                    provider VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    slug VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    indexed_generation VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    title VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    normalized_title VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    media_type_hint VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    relative_path VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    last_indexed_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY (provider, slug, indexed_generation)
                )

CREATE TABLE "providerepisodelanguage" (
                    provider VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    slug VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    season INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    episode INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    language VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    indexed_generation VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    normalized_language VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    host_hints JSON,
                    last_indexed_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY (
                        provider,
                        slug,
                        season,
                        episode,
                        language,
                        indexed_generation
                    )
                )

CREATE TABLE "providerepisodemapping" (
            provider VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            slug VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            provider_season INTEGER NOT NULL,
            provider_episode INTEGER NOT NULL,
            tvdb_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            canonical_season INTEGER NOT NULL,
            canonical_episode INTEGER NOT NULL,
            indexed_generation VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            confidence VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            source VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            rationale VARCHAR,
            last_verified_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (
                provider,
                slug,
                provider_season,
                provider_episode,
                tvdb_id,
                canonical_season,
                canonical_episode,
                indexed_generation
            )
        )

CREATE TABLE providerindexstatus (
	provider VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	refresh_interval_hours FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	current_generation VARCHAR, 
	latest_success_generation VARCHAR, 
	latest_started_at DATETIME, 
	latest_completed_at DATETIME, 
	latest_success_at DATETIME, 
	next_refresh_after DATETIME, 
	bootstrap_completed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_error_summary VARCHAR, 
	cursor_title_slug VARCHAR, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, active_stage VARCHAR, title_index_status VARCHAR DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, title_index_ready_at DATETIME, title_index_next_retry_after DATETIME, detail_enrichment_status VARCHAR DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, detail_ready_at DATETIME, detail_next_retry_after DATETIME, canonical_enrichment_status VARCHAR DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, canonical_ready_at DATETIME, canonical_next_retry_after DATETIME, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_providerindexstatus PRIMARY KEY (provider)
)

CREATE TABLE "providermoviemapping" (
            provider VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            slug VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            tmdb_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            indexed_generation VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            confidence VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            source VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            rationale VARCHAR,
            last_verified_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (provider, slug, tmdb_id, indexed_generation)
        )

CREATE TABLE "providerseriesmapping" (
            provider VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            slug VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            tvdb_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            indexed_generation VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            confidence VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            source VARCHAR NOT NULL,
            rationale VARCHAR,
            last_verified_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (provider, slug, tvdb_id, indexed_generation)
        )

CREATE TABLE providertitleindexstate (
	provider VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	last_attempted_at DATETIME, 
	last_success_at DATETIME, 
	failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_error_summary VARCHAR, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, detail_status VARCHAR DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, detail_last_attempted_at DATETIME, detail_last_success_at DATETIME, detail_next_retry_after DATETIME, detail_failure_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, detail_last_error_summary VARCHAR, canonical_status VARCHAR DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, canonical_last_attempted_at DATETIME, canonical_last_success_at DATETIME, canonical_next_retry_after DATETIME, canonical_failure_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, canonical_last_error_summary VARCHAR, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_providertitleindexstate PRIMARY KEY (provider, slug)
)

CREATE TABLE strmurlmapping (
	site VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	season INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	episode INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	language VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	resolved_url VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	provider_used VARCHAR, 
	resolved_headers JSON, 
	resolved_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_strmurlmapping PRIMARY KEY (site, slug, season, episode, language, provider)
)
